quests.instruction: Kai's bike ride starts at 8°C and ends at 18°C an hour later. Which clothing system suits it best?
quests.correctAnswer: Thin base layer, packable fleece, windproof shell 🚲
options: One very thick winter coat all the way 🧥
A cotton hoodie and nothing else 🧥
Thin base layer, packable fleece, windproof shell 🚲
quests.hint: The temperature changes and he's moving.
quests.explanation: Layers can be added or removed as he warms up, and a windproof shell protects him on cold downhills.
quests.funFact: Cyclists feel wind chill from their own speed.

quests.instruction: Kai sweats in a cotton hoodie on the ride, then coasts downhill into a cool wind. What is likely to happen?
quests.correctAnswer: The damp cotton makes him chilly 🥶
options: The damp cotton makes him chilly 🥶
The wind makes him hot 🔥
The hoodie keeps him dry ☀️
quests.explanation: Damp cotton stays wet, and wind carries away heat, so he feels cold.
quests.funFact: Sweat that can't escape chills you when you stop moving.

quests.instruction: Which socks best fit an hour-long ride in cold, dry weather?
quests.correctAnswer: Thin wool-blend socks inside closed shoes 🧦
options: Thin wool-blend socks inside closed shoes 🧦
Thick cotton socks that hold sweat 🧦
No socks and open sandals 🩴
quests.explanation: Wool blends stay warm and handle sweat. Thin socks fit in shoes without squeezing.
quests.funFact: Wool can keep you warm even when slightly damp.

quests.instruction: Rain runs down Noor's sleeves and into her jacket. Which feature would solve it?
quests.correctAnswer: Elastic or adjustable cuffs 🧥
options: A taller collar around the neck 👔
Deeper pockets on the front 👖
Elastic or adjustable cuffs 🧥
quests.hint: The problem is at the wrists.
quests.explanation: Snug cuffs keep rain from running up inside the sleeves.
quests.funFact: Cuffs with hook-and-loop straps can be adjusted over gloves.

quests.instruction: Cold air blows up under Mia's jacket when she bends over. Which feature helps?
quests.correctAnswer: A drawcord hem or longer back 🧥
options: A bigger hood at the neck 🧥
A shorter sleeve length 💪
A drawcord hem or longer back 🧥
quests.hint: The gap is at the bottom.
quests.explanation: A drawcord hem tightens the bottom, and a longer back covers the waist when bending.
quests.funFact: Many jackets are cut longer in the back for this reason.

quests.instruction: Ravi's gloves keep slipping off in the wind. Which feature helps?
quests.correctAnswer: An elastic wrist closure 🧤
options: Longer fingers on the gloves 🖐️
An elastic wrist closure 🧤
A bigger thumb section 👍
quests.hint: They're falling off at the wrist.
quests.explanation: An elastic wrist holds gloves on and stops cold air from sneaking in.
quests.funFact: Some gloves have a long cuff to go over a coat sleeve.

quests.instruction: Zoya is going to an outdoor festival with muddy, wet grass and lots of walking. She wants dry feet, grip, and comfort. Which shoes fit?
quests.correctAnswer: Rain boots with a grippy sole 🥾
options: Rain boots with a grippy sole 🥾
Flat sandals with thin soles 🩴
Canvas sneakers that soak up water 👟
quests.hint: Check each shoe against dry, grippy, and comfortable.
quests.explanation: Rain boots keep feet dry and tread gives grip. Comfortable socks keep them from rubbing.
quests.funFact: Mud pulls at shoes, so a snug fit helps.

quests.instruction: Heavy, wet snow is forecast all day. Sam's bag has room for one more item. Which is the best choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Spare dry socks 🧦
options: Sunglasses for the glare 🕶️
A sun hat for bright days 👒
Spare dry socks 🧦
quests.explanation: Wet feet are the biggest comfort problem, so dry socks are the most valuable thing to carry.
quests.funFact: Wet snow soaks into most things.

quests.instruction: On a long, hot hike, Priya can bring only two clothing items. Which two give the most help?
quests.correctAnswer: A light long-sleeved shirt and a wide-brim hat 👒
options: A raincoat and rain boots 🌧️
A light long-sleeved shirt and a wide-brim hat 👒
A fleece and mittens 🧤
quests.explanation: The shirt and hat protect from sun without adding heat.
quests.funFact: Sun protection matters even if you don't feel hot.

quests.instruction: Jacket A is fully waterproof but not very breathable. Jacket B is water-resistant and breathable. Which is better for a 10-minute walk in very heavy rain?
quests.correctAnswer: Jacket A 🧥
options: Neither ❌
Jacket B 🧥
Jacket A 🧥
quests.explanation: For a short walk in heavy rain, full waterproofing matters more than breathability.
quests.funFact: Waterproof fabrics often use a coating or film.

quests.instruction: Now look at the same two jackets. Which is better for several hours of hard hiking in light drizzle?
quests.correctAnswer: Jacket B 🧥
options: Neither ❌
Jacket B 🧥
Jacket A 🧥
quests.hint: Long time, hard work, light water.
quests.explanation: Hard work makes you sweat, so breathability matters. Light drizzle doesn't need full waterproofing.
quests.funFact: Sweat can make you as wet as rain.

quests.instruction: Down and fleece are both warm. Which keeps its warmth better when it gets wet?
quests.correctAnswer: Fleece 🐑
options: Fleece 🐑
Down 🪶
Neither 🤷
quests.explanation: Down clumps when wet and loses its insulation. Fleece keeps more warmth even when damp.
quests.funFact: Some down is treated to resist water.

quests.instruction: A jacket has a stiff-brimmed hood, taped seams, underarm vents, and reflective strips. What was it designed for?
quests.correctAnswer: Hiking or walking in rainy weather 🥾
options: Sleeping in a warm bedroom 🛏️
Hiking or walking in rainy weather 🥾
Swimming laps in a heated pool 🏊
quests.hint: Read each feature as a clue.
quests.explanation: Hood and taped seams keep rain out, vents let heat out, and reflective strips help visibility.
quests.funFact: Underarm vents are called pit zips.

quests.instruction: A boot has a tall shaft, deep treads, a warm lining, and a waterproof layer. Where would it be most useful?
quests.correctAnswer: Cold, wet, uneven ground ❄️
options: A smooth gym floor 🏀
A hot, dry beach 🏖️
Cold, wet, uneven ground ❄️
quests.explanation: Each feature handles snow, cold, and slippery ground.
quests.funFact: Tall shafts keep snow from dropping in.

quests.instruction: A shirt is lightweight, has mesh panels, long sleeves with thumb loops, and a UV label. What is it best for?
quests.correctAnswer: Sunny outdoor activity ☀️
options: Rainy bus rides 🚌
Sunny outdoor activity ☀️
Cold mountain nights 🏔️
quests.hint: The clues point to sun and airflow.
quests.explanation: Mesh panels let air through, and long sleeves with a UV label protect skin from the sun.
quests.funFact: UPF ratings tell how much UV a fabric blocks.

quests.instruction: After a rainy hike, Mei's boots and socks are soaked. What is the best sequence?
quests.correctAnswer: Take off wet boots and socks, dry feet, put on dry socks 🧦
options: Keep the wet boots on until she is home 🥾
Put dry socks on over the wet ones 🧦
Take off wet boots and socks, dry feet, put on dry socks 🧦
quests.explanation: Removing wet socks and drying feet prevents chilling and blisters.
quests.funFact: Wet feet lose heat much faster than dry feet, which is why hikers carry spare socks.

quests.instruction: The next morning, her boots are still damp inside. What should she do before another hike?
quests.correctAnswer: Dry them fully or use a different pair 🥾
options: Wear them damp and hope they dry 😣
Dry them fully or use a different pair 🥾
Seal them in a bag until next time 🛍️
quests.explanation: Damp boots rub and chill, and can grow mold. Fully dry ones feel better.
quests.funFact: Newspaper helps absorb moisture.

quests.instruction: Why is airing out a damp rain jacket important after use?
quests.correctAnswer: Damp fabric smells and loses its water protection 🧥
options: Damp fabric smells and loses its water protection 🧥
Damp fabric makes the jacket warmer 🔥
Damp fabric makes the jacket shrink 📉
quests.explanation: Damp fabric can grow bacteria and mold, and rain jackets work better when clean and dry.
quests.funFact: Wash tags tell how to care for waterproof clothing.

quests.instruction: A heat wave has arrived, and an outdoor lesson is at noon. Which plan is the safest?
quests.correctAnswer: Move to shade, wear light clothes and a hat, drink water 💧
options: Skip drinking water until the lesson ends 🚫
Move to shade, wear light clothes and a hat, drink water 💧
Wear dark thick clothes and stay in the sun 🖤
quests.explanation: Shade, light clothing, a hat, and water help prevent overheating.
quests.funFact: Hot noon sun is strongest around midday.

quests.instruction: Kai's shoulders are sunburned after a day outdoors. What clothing choice helps the next day?
quests.correctAnswer: Cover them with loose, light clothing 👕
options: Cover them with loose, light clothing 👕
Wrap a wet towel over them 💦
Wear a tight tank top instead 🎽
quests.explanation: Loose, light clothing shades the burned skin without rubbing it.
quests.funFact: Sunburned skin needs rest from more sun.

quests.instruction: At a hot noon sports day, Kai's dark, thick team jersey feels too hot. If allowed, what is a smart adjustment?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear a lighter-colored breathable shirt 👕
options: Add a second thick jersey on top 👕
Wear a fleece underneath it 🐑
Wear a lighter-colored breathable shirt 👕
quests.hint: Which color and fabric reflect more sunlight?
quests.explanation: A lighter, breathable shirt reflects more sun and lets heat out.
quests.funFact: Teams sometimes allow lighter uniforms in hot weather.

quests.instruction: Wet, heavy snow is falling. Which fabric should Ravi avoid for a middle layer?
quests.correctAnswer: Cotton 🧶
options: Cotton 🧶
Fleece 🐑
Wool 🐑
quests.hint: One soaks up water and stays cold.
quests.explanation: Cotton holds water and loses warmth when damp. Fleece and wool keep more warmth.
quests.funFact: Layers closest to the skin matter most.

quests.instruction: Why should Lina check her fingers and toes during long cold outdoor play?
quests.correctAnswer: They get cold first and can be hurt by the cold 🥶
options: They get too hot in the snow 🔥
They get bigger in the cold 📈
They get cold first and can be hurt by the cold 🥶
quests.hint: These body parts are far from the body's core.
quests.explanation: Cold fingers and toes are early warnings. Going inside to warm up protects them.
quests.funFact: Numbness is a warning sign.

quests.instruction: Tomás is in snow at -5°C under bright sun. He is warm in his coat but his cheeks are cold. What would help?
quests.correctAnswer: A neck gaiter or face covering 🧣
options: A neck gaiter or face covering 🧣
A wide-brim sun hat 👒
A thin pair of ankle socks 🧦
quests.explanation: A neck gaiter shields the cheeks and nose from cold wind.
quests.funFact: Cheeks and noses are exposed in snow.

quests.instruction: Which coat is more practical for a muddy schoolyard?
quests.correctAnswer: A dark waterproof coat that wipes clean 🧥
options: A white wool coat with a soft collar 🧶
A dark waterproof coat that wipes clean 🧥
A silk jacket with shiny buttons 🧥
quests.explanation: A dark, wipeable coat is easy to keep tidy and holds up to mud.
quests.funFact: Dark coats hide mud better, and waterproof fabric can be wiped clean with a damp cloth.

quests.instruction: A growing child needs a new winter coat. What is a good choice?
quests.correctAnswer: One that fits now with a little room to grow 📏
options: One that is three sizes too big 🎒
One that fits now with a little room to grow 📏
One that is far too small now 😖
quests.explanation: A coat with a little extra room lasts longer, but too big gets in the way.
quests.funFact: Sleeves that are too long can be folded.

quests.instruction: A neighbor offers hand-me-down boots. What should be checked first?
quests.correctAnswer: Fit, and wear on the soles and inside 🥾
options: Only how shiny they look ✨
Only the color of the laces 🎨
Fit, and wear on the soles and inside 🥾
quests.explanation: Boots must fit well and not be worn out, or they won't protect.
quests.funFact: Soles with smooth, worn tread slip.

quests.instruction: It is windy, 3°C, and drizzling. Priya will walk forty minutes, then sit in a cold classroom. Which plan works best?
quests.correctAnswer: Base layer, fleece, waterproof hooded shell, hat, gloves 🧥
options: Raincoat over a T-shirt and shorts 🌧️
Base layer, fleece, waterproof hooded shell, hat, gloves 🧥
Cotton hoodie and a large umbrella ☂️
quests.hint: Consider the walk and the wait.
quests.explanation: Layers keep her warm, the shell keeps out wind and rain, and dry socks help her warm up in the classroom.
quests.funFact: After a walk, changing wet items helps you warm up.

quests.instruction: What is the most important reason to wear layers?
quests.correctAnswer: You can adjust your warmth as conditions change 🧥
options: You can adjust your warmth as conditions change 🧥
They make your clothes look more interesting ✨
They make you look taller than you are 📏
quests.explanation: Layers can be added or removed, which helps keep you comfortable.
quests.funFact: Mountain climbers carry extra layers for this reason.

quests.instruction: An outfit that works in one situation can fail in another. Which example shows this?
quests.correctAnswer: A cotton hoodie is cozy when dry but poor in cold rain 🧥
options: A cotton hoodie is cozy when dry but poor in cold rain 🧥
A raincoat works well when it is raining 🌧️
Rain boots keep feet dry in the rain 🥾
quests.explanation: The same hoodie that feels good in dry weather soaks up rain and loses warmth.
quests.funFact: Good choices depend on weather and activity.
